declarations.name: operatorBuresRootFidelity_nonneg
declarations.doc: The operator Bures root fidelity is nonnegative.

declarations.name: operatorBuresRootFidelity
declarations.doc: Operator Bures root fidelity, defined as the nuclear norm of `sqrt(C) sqrt(M)`.

declarations.name: operatorBuresRootFidelity_sq_le_targetProbabilityBuresCapacity
declarations.doc: Every admissible target probability design lies below the exact order capacity.

declarations.name: operatorBuresRootFidelity_eq_finiteMatrix
declarations.doc: Operator Bures root fidelity equals the established matrix Bures root fidelity on every finite-dimensional Hilbert space.

declarations.name: operatorBuresRootFidelity_le_separableReporterHalfSum
declarations.doc: Infinite Alberti lower law.** Every bounded strictly-positive invertible reporter dominates the Bures root fidelity of an arbitrary positive Schatten-one pair.

declarations.name: rectTraceNorm_sheetTargetIncidence_eq_operatorBuresRootFidelity
declarations.doc: Infinite incidence/Bures nuclear identity (INC2).** No rank, injectivity, finite-dimensional, or closed-range assumption is required.

declarations.name: continuousOn_operatorBuresRootFidelity_compactTargetBody
declarations.doc: Bures root fidelity against a fixed Hilbert--Schmidt source root is continuous on the entire infinite-dimensional compact target body in its trace-norm topology.

declarations.name: norm_inner_le_operatorBuresRootFidelity
declarations.doc: Infinite diagonal coupling/Bures law.** For arbitrary Bochner `L²` fields on a separable Hilbert space, the absolute diagonal overlap is bounded by the exact operator Bures root fidelity of their trace-class covariances.

declarations.name: exists_extremal_operatorBuresRootFidelity_compactTargetBody
declarations.doc: On every nonempty norm-compact occupied target family, both worst and best Bures target covariances are attained in the infinite-dimensional trace-norm compact body.

declarations.name: exists_countable_complete_design_operatorBuresRootFidelity_sq_lower
declarations.doc: Complete countable-union separable incidence law.** A first-hit measurable selector converts the entire countable target union into one normalized phase-corrected design. Hence the complete union costs no target cardinality factor, even for infinitely many targets.

declarations.name: spinChartDensity_bures_sq
declarations.doc: The corpus's full matrix Bures fidelity agrees with spinor fidelity on the constructed densities.

declarations.name: finiteBuresRootFidelity_eq_one_iff
declarations.doc: Root fidelity one exactly characterizes equality of density matrices.

declarations.name: spinDensityFlow_bures_sq
declarations.doc: The actual density trajectory inherits the previously proved spinor-fidelity law.

declarations.name: finiteBuresRootFidelity_comm
declarations.doc: Finite Bures root fidelity is symmetric on positive semidefinite matrices.

declarations.name: finiteBuresRootFidelity_diagonal_ofReal
declarations.doc: Bures root fidelity of real nonnegative diagonal matrices is exactly their classical Hellinger affinity.
